purpose: Teach: 糞/ガール/うーむ/じゃぁ/仔/菊/帖/フン

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが「糞、悔しい」と素直に仰った日があった
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, there was a day he said 'Damn it, how frustrating' — so unlike him to show it.
lines.style: Soft, remembering. Gentle lift on the memory itself. Long pause before speaking, as if watching it happen again in his mind. Warm but distant, the way old men hold precious things.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、私の事を「ガール時代から見て来た」と仰ったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — your grandfather, he said he'd been watching me since my girl days, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Bright recollection, almost conspiratorial. A little teasing in the question at the end. Warm, reaching toward him with the memory. Voice lifts gently on 'dear' — checking that he remembers too.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが「うーむ、見事だ」と感嘆された
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father once said 'Hmm, that's admirable' — his way of giving praise.
lines.style: Quieter this time. Respectful. Lets the sentence breathe around the memory. Voice settles on the praise like it's something that still matters. Almost reverent.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、「じゃぁ、今夜は鍋にしよう」って仰ってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather said, 'Well then, let's make hot pot tonight' — do you remember, dear?
lines.style: Animated, warm. A small laugh underneath, like she can taste it still. Practical and affectionate at once. The 'dear' is a gentle anchor, making sure he's following along with her.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが仔牛、つまり子牛を世話された
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father took care of a calf — a young one.
lines.style: Simple, quiet. No flourish. The kind of detail that meant something to him. Slow delivery, respectful of the smallness of the work. Honest remembrance.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、菊の品評会に出品されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather entered a chrysanthemum show when he was young — the specimens he grew, dear.
lines.style: Bright with pride, but restrained. Warm knowing in the voice. The detail of flowers brings her joy visibly. Affectionate question at the end, inviting him into the pride.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが六帖の書斎で読書された
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father would read in that six-mat study of his for hours.
lines.style: Contemplative, a little wistful. The detail of the room size is specific, beloved. Unhurried pace. Voice suggests watching him bent over a book, lost in another world.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、「フン、まだまだだ」と謙虚に仰ったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather, when he was young, he'd say 'Hmph, still has much to learn' — so modest, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle affection mixed with tender teasing. Voice softens toward the end. The 'dear' is intimate, like she's sharing a secret only they know. Small, knowing smile in the voice.
